checks.s: The redline changes the demand registration trigger to 4 years post-closing.
The redline retains the alternative demand registration trigger of 180 days after IPO, so demand registration is available at the earlier of 4 years post-closing or 180 days after IPO.
The redline accepts 3 demand registrations without further modification.
The redline includes an S-3 short-form demand registration right.
The redline sets the minimum aggregate offering price for S-3 demand registrations at $5,000,000.
The redline sets the delivery period for annual audited financials at 120 days after fiscal year-end.
The redline sets the delivery period for quarterly unaudited financials at 45 days after quarter-end.
The redline includes a requirement to deliver monthly unaudited financials.
The redline sets the delivery deadline for monthly unaudited financials at 30 days after month-end.
The redline sets the information rights qualifying threshold at 400,000 shares of Preferred (as-converted).
The redline requires 10 business days' notice to exercise the inspection/books-and-records right.
The redline requires the inspecting holder to execute a confidentiality undertaking before inspection.
The redline sets the board observer qualifying threshold at ≥4,000,000 shares.
The redline gives the Company the right to exclude the board observer from portions of meetings involving attorney-client privileged matters.
The redline gives the Company the right to exclude the board observer from portions of meetings involving conflicts of interest.
The redline requires the board observer to sign a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) as a condition to exercising observer rights.
The redline sets the Major Investor threshold for pro rata/preemptive rights at 750,000 shares.
The redline deletes Verdana's super pro rata / overallotment right to purchase unsubscribed shares before the Company offers them to third parties.
The cover note explains that the super pro rata / overallotment right is rejected because it creates an effective right of first refusal that would chill future fundraising.
The redline sets the pro rata exercise period at 20 days.
The redline limits ROFR/co-sale to the Key Holders listed on Exhibit A: Dr. Elaine Matsuda, Dr. Rajiv Anand, and Marcus Teller.
The redline includes a drag-along provision.
The redline requires both a majority of Common and 70% of Preferred to approve a drag-along transaction.
The redline limits the 180-day post-IPO lock-up to Key Holders and directors only.
The redline carves out sales under Rule 10b5-1 plans established before the IPO from the lock-up provision.
The redline provides for early release of locked-up holders if the underwriter releases any other locked-up holder.
The Series B-specific veto over new indebtedness applies to indebtedness exceeding $3,000,000.
The redline deletes Verdana's Series B-specific veto over any single capital expenditure exceeding $500,000.
The cover note characterizes the capital expenditure veto as operational micromanagement or as an inappropriate level of investor control over day-to-day operations.
The Series B-specific hiring/termination veto is limited to the CEO and CFO only.
The Series B-specific veto over related-party transactions applies only to transactions exceeding $120,000.
The redline limits the option pool veto to increases exceeding 5% of fully diluted shares.
